title: Typed entity, block, and TABLE callback cardinality bounds
head: de27a3391a624aba03ca71f3583c4b3a6e6396a9
scope: Bound persistent dx_iface block-definition, typed entity, and DRW_Table callback retention by container-lifetime record cardinality
Route entity allocation and list insertion through exception-safe sticky capture admission
Refuse DXF output after partial/over-limit typed entity callback capture
Add generated fast coverage without adding a DWG/DXF fixture

controls: Typed entity copies use one aggregate container-lifetime record counter
Entity allocation and list insertion are enclosed by admission and exception handling
Block definitions are not allocated/copied after their record ceiling
DRW_Table copies and their compatibility entity callback are rejected after their record ceiling
Any capture/allocation failure is sticky and DXF export refuses before publishing output
implementation.limitations: Count ceilings only. No aggregate dynamic-byte estimate was added for nested entity/table payloads, block end-record members, or every auxiliary callback store. This is not a complete adapter memory bound or format/support qualification.

localEvidence: Generated in-memory DRW_Line callback reaches the exact typed entity record ceiling; the next callback is refused and the count/list remain unchanged.
Generated block-definition and DRW_Table callbacks are refused at their respective ceilings.
A capture refusal prevents fileExport from replacing an existing sentinel destination.
No persistent or downloaded drawing fixture was added.

planImpact.remainingCensus: Typed entity/block/TABLE record cardinality is bounded; dynamic payload bytes, end-block data, and remaining auxiliary callback stores still need an owner-by-owner audit.

method.limitations: The repository .git metadata is read-only in this session, so the slice remains uncommitted.
